`store/memo.go` — the `type Memo struct` definition (line 35) plus `CreateMemo`/`ListMemos`/`UpdateMemo`
`store/driver.go` — the `Driver` interface signatures that pass `*Memo`

Persistence layer, one per dialect — these read and write every field, so a field change means SQL and scan changes in all three:

`store/db/sqlite/memo.go`
`store/db/postgres/memo.go`

Tests that construct `store.Memo` literals and will break on field changes:

`store/test/memo_relation_test.go`, `store/test/memo_test.go`, `store/test/filter_helpers_test.go`, `store/test/user_delete_test.go`, `store/test/migrator_test.go`, `store/test/migrator_upgrade_test.go`, `store/test/memo_filter_test.go`
`server/router/api/v1/sse_hub_test.go`, `server/router/api/v1/test/user_service_stats_test.go`, `server/router/api/v1/test/memo_service_test.go`, `server/router/api/v1/test/memo_service_benchmark_test.go`
`server/router/rss/rss_test.go`, `server/router/frontend/frontend_test.go`

Two caveats on scope. This list comes from matching the `store.Memo` qualifier (plus unqualified `*Memo` inside the `store` package), so code that only touches related types like `FindMemo`, `UpdateMemo`, or `MemoRelation` isn't included even though a schema-level change would often ripple there. Also, if the change involves the `Payload` field, the proto-generated `storepb.MemoPayload` in `proto/gen/store` and the SQL migrations under `store/migration/{mysql,postgres,sqlite}` would need matching updates.
